observations: The G2 owner source closes the generation-1 prediction-only run-id relabel by requiring an exact builder-originated WP800 RunDescriptor, descriptor/fixture match, prediction run-id match, and prediction policy-id to descriptor system-under-test match before step_episode.

benchmark_generation remains caller-controlled on PredictionCandidate and is not bound to RunDescriptor or another evaluator-side admitted generation identity. Replacing benchmark_generation with 999999 is still accepted and copied into PredictionEvaluation.

RunDescriptor.for_fixture remains available as a fresh builder-originated descriptor factory. A prediction whose benchmark_run_id and policy_id are jointly relabeled can be paired with a freshly built descriptor carrying the same forged run-id/SUT identity; the G2 evaluator accepts the pair because no predeclared/admitted run-manifest identity or digest is supplied independently of the pair under evaluation.
counterhypothesis: If the benchmark contract intentionally treats benchmark_generation and the RunDescriptor factory output as self-declared per-evaluation metadata rather than authenticated predeclared run provenance, the observed acceptance is not a source bug; in that case the generation-2 claim language must be narrowed so it does not imply independently rooted exact run/generation ancestry.
recommended_discriminator: Require an evaluator-side predeclared RunManifest/RunAdmission identity with generation plus descriptor digest, or another independently rooted immutable run binding, created before candidate scoring. Then add regressions proving that relabeling benchmark_generation or jointly replacing candidate run/SUT plus descriptor cannot be accepted by minting a fresh matching descriptor.

coordination.rule: Existing generation-2 owner absorbs or explicitly narrows this evidence; no duplicate successor is created by this organ.

next_exact_action: Route this review evidence to the sole F2-WP-803 generation-2 mutation authority. The owner should either bind benchmark_generation and a predeclared immutable run-manifest/admission digest before evaluator scoring, or narrow the accepted provenance claim. Re-run the exact negative controls on the repaired owner head before bounded G2 acceptance.
